# exo_resource_config (Data Source)

Look up an existing ResourceConfig object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `resource_property_schema` (String) Maps to the -ResourcePropertySchema parameter.
